comment: Recognition layer 3: landmark popups. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon, projected into world space via the route origin+scale at load. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. Each landmark has a stable id from creation (standing rule - the future ad system depends on this pattern). narrator_event overrides the default 'landmark.enter' event when set — lets special stops have dedicated narrator lines.

landmarks.name: Gun Boat Beach
landmarks.fact: Harbour-side bathing spot on the Palisadoes strip

landmarks.name: National Stadium
landmarks.fact: Home of Jamaican track and football glory — Excelsior High is just across Mountain View Avenue

landmarks.name: Devon House
landmarks.fact: 1881 mansion of George Stiebel, Jamaica's first black millionaire — and legendary ice cream

landmarks.name: Half Way Tree Clock Tower
landmarks.fact: The 1813 clock tower at the crossroads of Kingston

landmarks.name: Flat Bridge
landmarks.fact: Historic one-lane bridge over the Rio Cobre in Bog Walk gorge

landmarks.name: Faith's Pen
landmarks.fact: Legendary roadside stop — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival

landmarks.name: Dunn's River Falls
landmarks.fact: Jamaica's famous climbable waterfall — journey's end
